targets.query: from(bucket: "metrics") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "disk_metrics" and (r._field == "read_rate_bps" or r._field == "write_rate_bps")) |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "metrics") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "disk_metrics" and (r._field == "reads_completed" or r._field == "writes_completed")) |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "metrics") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "disk_metrics" and r._field == "utilization_percent") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
